reviews.author: Christoph Hellwig
reviews.summary: Expressed general approval of the patch series from a high-level perspective, but did not provide detailed technical feedback or analysis.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Oct 07, 2026 at 05:34:42PM +0200, Alexandre Ghiti wrote:
> Since commit 8f29aa226f82 ("mm/swap: introduce struct swap_io_ctx"),
> reclaim merges the swap writes of folios with consecutive slots into a
> single bio, but zswap writeback still issues one IO per entry. Patch 1
> makes each zswap LRU walk batch its writeback IO. Patch 2 plugs the
> walk, so that the block layer can merge what the batch cannot.

No a zswap expert, but from the high-level perspective this looks
great.

2026-10-08.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the writeback IO performance of zswap by batching consecutive entries and allowing the block layer to merge them. The patches modify the mm/zswap.c file, introducing a new LRU walk batch mechanism and plugging it into the existing code.
